Each per-listing failure (network/5xx/429 under the N-call fan-out) is collapsed to null by `.getOrNull()` and then dropped by `.filterNotNull()`, yet the function still returns Result.success(...). Totals (totalViews/totalInquiries/totalFavorites at :132-134) and the viewsTrend/inquiriesTrend arrays (:150-151) are therefore computed from a partial subset of listings with no partial-failure flag on PortfolioAnalytics and no minimum-success threshold.

The Realtor ListingAnalytics screen (androidApp Navigation.kt:497-, comment at :498-500 cites this method) renders these portfolio metrics as authoritative, so a transient failure on even one listing silently understates portfolio-wide views/inquiries/favorites with zero indication to the realtor that the figures are incomplete. Confidence MEDIUM: statically certain failures are dropped; exact user impact depends on how often the fan-out partially fails at runtime. Fix: surface a partial-failure indicator (e.g. count of listings whose analytics could not be loaded) or fail the aggregate when a threshold of per-listing calls error.
